rev.t: Thank you very much for all the staff and mentor for beautiful day.  Good memories  for whole family 👪 …
Perfect place for classical music and dance program. But parking is little tough. Cozy family functions can also be done and enough space is there to have food also.

This is in a Good location in malleswaram. Plenty of parking 4 wheelers and 2 wheelers on the wide street in the front of the premises. The hall is good enough for some 400people. The acoustics is great and the sound system and the lighting …
